name: @dickpy/dsh-imagegen
description: AI image generation plugin for the dsh web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image through configurable provider channels (gpt-image-2 / grok-imagine-image / nanobanana series / seedream-5.0-pro / dall-e-3, with native xAI Grok Imagine, Google Nano Banana and ByteDance Seedream request shaping), per-channel model catalogs, a three-column studio beside the native conversation, an infinite canvas with node-graph workflows (annotation boxes with attached prompt cards, local background removal, AI layer split, per-node model choice, file nodes with any-file upload, and a canvas skill system covering skill-driven next steps on every node: text polish, image description, content extraction, and a host-driven image-to-editable-ppt pipeline that rebuilds the visual layer from measured pixels (the legacy headless-agent driver stays selectable), with a local skill library that installs and removes skills from URLs or uploaded archives), an ecommerce product-set mode and a prompt template library.

scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:remote && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:remote: pnpm run build && pnpm exec tsdown --config scripts/remote-settings.config.ts && node --test scripts/remote-access.test.mjs scripts/remote-access-routes.test.mjs scripts/remote-settings-client.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit: node --test scripts/conversation-sync.test.mjs scripts/agent-image-config.test.mjs scripts/image-clipboard.test.mjs scripts/engine-openai-size.test.mjs scripts/reference-clipboard.test.mjs scripts/generation-duration.test.mjs scripts/generation-settings.test.mjs scripts/studio-state.test.mjs scripts/engine-capabilities.test.mjs
scripts.test:duration:browser: pnpm exec tsdown --config scripts/generation-preview.config.ts && pnpm exec tsdown --config scripts/result-preview.config.ts && node scripts/generation-duration-browser-test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm exec tsdown --config scripts/conversation-preview.config.ts && node scripts/conversation-dom-e2e.mjs && pnpm exec tsdown --config scripts/toolview-preview.config.ts && node scripts/toolview-dom-e2e.mjs && pnpm run test:references && pnpm run test:history
scripts.test:references: pnpm exec tsdown --config scripts/references-preview.config.ts && node scripts/references-dom-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:browser: pnpm exec tsdown --config scripts/conversation-preview.config.ts && node scripts/conversation-browser-test.mjs
scripts.test:studio:browser: pnpm exec tsdown --config scripts/studio-preview.config.ts && node scripts/studio-browser-test.mjs
scripts.test:history:browser: pnpm exec tsdown --config scripts/studio-preview.config.ts && node scripts/history-browser-test.mjs
scripts.test:history: pnpm exec tsdown --config scripts/studio-preview.config.ts && node scripts/history-dom-e2e.mjs
